title: Self-Aware Vector Embeddings for Retrieval-Augmented Generation: A Neuroscience-Inspired Framework for Temporal, Confidence-Weighted, and Relational Knowledge
why_relevant: Proposes a framework that augments embeddings with temporal validity, confidence decay, and relational edges to handle stale/contradictory retrieval, contradiction injection robustness, and calibration (ECE). Touches conflict resolution and confidence-weighted retrieval.
why_not_or_caveat: Evaluated only on a small synthetic benchmark; quality and impact unclear; appears to be a preprint with limited validation.
